# GeoAtlas MEA

> The geospatial industry directory for the Middle East and Africa. 738 survey firms, GIS and BIM consultancies, equipment manufacturers and dealers, software vendors, agencies, universities and professional bodies across 70 countries, in 146 categories and four sections. Free to search; data downloadable as CSV and JSON (CC BY 4.0).

## Key pages
- [Directory search](https://risegeouae.ae/directory.html)
- [Brands and where to buy](https://risegeouae.ae/brands.html)
- [Countries](https://risegeouae.ae/countries.html)
- [FAQ](https://risegeouae.ae/faq.html)
- [About & methodology](https://risegeouae.ae/about.html)

## Guides
- [How to hire a land surveyor in the Middle East and Africa](https://risegeouae.ae/guides/how-to-hire-a-land-surveyor.html): To hire a land surveyor in the Middle East or Africa, first confirm the firm is licensed by the national or emirate survey authority, then match its specialism (cadastral, topographic, construction or real estate) to your job. Ask for a written scope with the coordinate system, accuracy, deliverables and timeline, and compare at least three quotes.
- [Total station vs GNSS: which does your survey need?](https://risegeouae.ae/guides/total-station-vs-gnss.html): Use GNSS (RTK) for open sites where speed matters: it fixes a point to about 1 to 2 cm in seconds with one person. Use a total station where you need millimetre accuracy or have no clear sky view, such as inside buildings, between towers, under bridges or in tunnels. Most survey firms in the region use both.
- [ISO 19650 explained for Middle East project teams](https://risegeouae.ae/bim/iso-19650-explained.html): ISO 19650 is the international standard for managing information over the whole life of a built asset using BIM. It sets out who asks for what information (the client's requirements), how the delivery team plans and produces it (the BIM execution plan and delivery plans), and how it is shared and approved in a common data environment (CDE).
- [What is RTK, PPK and CORS?](https://risegeouae.ae/glossary/rtk-ppk-cors.html): RTK (real-time kinematic) corrects GNSS positions live using a base station or network, giving about 1 to 2 cm accuracy in the field. PPK (post-processed kinematic) applies the same corrections after the survey, in the office. CORS (continuously operating reference stations) are permanent base stations, often run by a national agency, that supply those corrections.

## Regulations
- [Regulations, licensing and standards](https://risegeouae.ae/regulations.html): survey licensing bodies and authorities by country
- [BIM Hub](https://risegeouae.ae/bim.html): ISO 19650, BEP, LOD, CDE, 4D/5D, FM, scan-to-BIM
- [BIM mandates tracker](https://risegeouae.ae/bim/mandates.html): Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Saudi BIM requirements with verification status

## Jobs
- [Geospatial jobs and internships](https://risegeouae.ae/jobs.html): survey, GIS, BIM, drone and hydrographic vacancies; employers post free
- [Land Surveyor & Survey Engineer Jobs](https://risegeouae.ae/jobs/land-surveyor-jobs.html): Land surveyor and survey engineer jobs in the Middle East and Africa usually ask for a diploma or degree in surveying or geomatics, field experience with GNSS and total stations, CAD skills, and for signing cadastral work, registration with the national surveying authority or council.
- [GIS Analyst & GIS Developer Jobs](https://risegeouae.ae/jobs/gis-jobs.html): GIS jobs in the region range from GIS technician and analyst roles in municipalities, utilities and consultancies to GIS developer roles building web maps and enterprise systems. Employers look for ArcGIS or QGIS skills, spatial databases and, increasingly, Python and web development.
- [BIM Modeller, Coordinator & Manager Jobs](https://risegeouae.ae/jobs/bim-jobs.html): BIM jobs in the Gulf follow a ladder from BIM modeller to BIM coordinator to BIM manager. Employers ask for Revit and Navisworks skills, clash detection and coordination experience, and for senior roles a working knowledge of ISO 19650, BIM execution plans and common data environments.
- [Drone Pilot & Photogrammetry Jobs](https://risegeouae.ae/jobs/drone-pilot-jobs.html): Drone survey jobs combine flying and data processing: a remote pilot licence from the national civil aviation authority, mapping-grade flight planning, ground control with GNSS, and processing in photogrammetry or LiDAR software into orthophotos, surface models and point clouds.
- [Hydrographic Surveyor Jobs](https://risegeouae.ae/jobs/hydrographic-surveyor-jobs.html): Hydrographic surveyors map the seabed, ports and waterways with single- and multibeam echo sounders and marine positioning. Many employers prefer qualifications from programmes recognised by the international FIG/IHO/ICA standards board (Category A or B), plus offshore safety certificates for vessel work.
- [Remote Sensing & Earth Observation Jobs](https://risegeouae.ae/jobs/remote-sensing-jobs.html): Remote sensing jobs in the region sit with space agencies, Earth observation companies and GIS consultancies. They ask for satellite image processing, classification and change detection, often with Python, cloud platforms and increasingly machine learning for feature extraction.
- [Survey Equipment Sales & Technical Support Jobs](https://risegeouae.ae/jobs/survey-equipment-sales-jobs.html): Survey equipment distributors and dealers hire sales engineers, product specialists and service technicians. These roles need hands-on knowledge of GNSS, total stations, scanners or drones, the ability to train customers, and for service roles, calibration and repair skills.
- [Geospatial Internships & Graduate Programmes](https://risegeouae.ae/jobs/internships.html): Survey, GIS and BIM internships in the Middle East and Africa are usually offered by consultancies, mapping agencies, municipalities and equipment dealers, often tied to university placement schemes. Apply early in the academic year with a CV, a short portfolio of maps or models, and your university's placement letter.

## Sections
- [Services](https://risegeouae.ae/section/services.html): Survey, mapping, drone, GIS and BIM service providers.
- [Products & Equipment](https://risegeouae.ae/section/products-equipment.html): Manufacturers, distributors, dealers, rental and repair for every type of survey equipment.
- [Software & Data](https://risegeouae.ae/section/software-data.html): Geospatial software vendors, resellers, implementation partners and data providers.
- [Institutions & Community](https://risegeouae.ae/section/institutions-community.html): Agencies, registries, universities, training, professional bodies, events and NGOs.
